FHNW Library Scale of Charges 
Declared by the President of the Board of Directors on: 15.12.2022 
Valid from: 01.01.2023 
Media delivery service 
(according to SLSP scale of charges 1, per medium) 
Courier service (per order including return) 2 CHF 8.00 
Mailing domestic (per medium) CHF 12.00 
Overdue fines 
(according to SLSP scale of charges, per medium 
Reminder/recall (by email) kostenlos 
1st overdue notice (by email) CHF 5.00 
2nd overdue notice (by email) CHF 5.00 
(Total CHF 10.00) 
3rd overdue notice (by post) CHF 10.00 
(Total CHF 20.00) 
Replacement purchase 
Media costs 3 effective costs 
Handling fee (per medium) CHF 20.00 
Digitisation request Switzerland and Liechtenstein 
Digital copies per 50 pages reproduced CHF 5.00 
Interlibrary lending 4 
Domestic CHF 12.00 
Europe CHF 24.00 
UK or intercontinental CHF 36.00 
Paper copies domestic (max. 50 pages per request) CHF 7.50 
Paper copies foreign countries (max. 50 pages per request) CHF 10.50 
1 https://slsp.ch/en/fees 
2 The SLSP courier is free of charge for members of the FHNW and 
school teachers employed in the canton of Aargau, provided the media 
is ordered at a location of the FHNW Library. 
3 Costs for replacement will also be incurred if replacement is not 
possible for various reasons. 
4 If the costs turn out to be higher, you will receive an offer in advance. 
Status: 01 January 2023
